request.text_prompt: Create original cold cinematic science-fiction game audio, approximately 5 seconds. Single large spacecraft explosion: immediate impact, deep expanding body, varied metal debris fading fully. Broad hull detonation with a rough tearing middle and scattered steel fragments. One self-contained event or specified short sequence; clear attack, natural decay, quiet clean tail; no abrupt truncation or long dead air. No vocals, singing, humming, speech, narration, lyrics or spoken prompt. No clipping, harsh distortion or unrelated scene sounds. No music, melody or soundtrack.
